nodes.summary: For a natural number $n$ and real $\beta$, this is the finite-volume free energy density of the Ising model on the periodic $(n + 1) \times (n + 1)$ square lattice at inverse temperature $\beta$, namely $\log Z_{n+1}(\beta) / (n + 1)^2$, where $Z_{n+1}(\beta)$ is the partition function of that lattice at inverse temperature $\beta$.
nodes.title: Ising free energy density along side lengths $n + 1$

nodes.summary: For a positive integer $L$ and real $\beta$, the free energy density of the Ising model on the periodic $L \times L$ square lattice is $\log Z_L(\beta) / L^2$, where $Z_L(\beta)$ is the partition function at inverse temperature $\beta$.
nodes.title: Finite-volume Ising free energy density

nodes.summary: For a positive integer $L$ and real $\beta$, let $Z_L(\beta)$ be the partition function of the zero-field ferromagnetic Ising model on the periodic $L \times L$ square lattice at inverse temperature $\beta$. nodes.title: Onsager's phase transition for the two-dimensional Ising model

nodes.title: Energy of an Ising configuration

nodes.summary: For a positive integer $L$ and real $\beta$, the partition function of the Ising model on the periodic $L \times L$ square lattice at inverse temperature $\beta$ is $Z_L(\beta) = \sum_\sigma e^{-\beta H_L(\sigma)}$, where $\sigma$ runs over all spin configurations on the lattice and $H_L(\sigma)$ is the Ising energy of $\sigma$.
nodes.title: Ising partition function

nodes.summary: For a positive integer $L$, the sites of the periodic $L \times L$ square lattice are the pairs $(i, j)$ with $i, j \in \mathbb{Z}/L\mathbb{Z}$.
nodes.title: Sites of the periodic square lattice

nodes.summary: For a positive integer $L$, the right neighbour of a site $(i, j)$ of the periodic $L \times L$ square lattice is $(i + 1, j)$, with addition in $\mathbb{Z}/L\mathbb{Z}$.
nodes.title: Right neighbour

nodes.summary: A spin, recorded as a Boolean, has the real value $1$ if it is true and $-1$ if it is false.
nodes.title: Numerical value of a spin

nodes.summary: For a positive integer $L$, the upward neighbour of a site $(i, j)$ of the periodic $L \times L$ square lattice is $(i, j + 1)$, with addition in $\mathbb{Z}/L\mathbb{Z}$.
nodes.title: Upward neighbour

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
